summary: Iteration 15 — Batch C + D (9 items). BACKEND 9/9 pytest green (login, /auth/me, /accounts/all, SimpleFIN link via scraped demo token, /payments/products, /payments/checkout coaching + membership → real checkout.stripe.com URLs, /coaching/bookings, /user/membership). FRONTEND (Playwright mobile 390x844, http://localhost:3000, localStorage.clear + reload each session; RN-Web onPress fired via el.click() through JS eval to avoid ScrollView-in-viewport coord issues): T1 12-month + annual auto-split — FULL PASS. All 12 Jan..Dec pills + Year pill horizontally scrollable. Default = current month 'Jul'. Tap Jul→Tithe opens sheet 'Set Jul · Tithe', enter 500 → row shows 'actual/budgeted $0/$500' with • override marker. Year pill → sheet 'Set annual · Tithe' → 6000 saves. Jan pill → Tithe auto-splits to $500 (=6000/12). Jan override → sheet 'Set Jan · Tithe' → 900 → row shows $900 with • marker. Reopen → 'Reset Jan to auto-split' present → tap → returns to $500 auto-split. T2 Add Category + Export CSV + long-press delete — PARTIAL PASS. 'Add Category' and 'Export to Excel' buttons present under summary strip. Add Category sheet works — 'Health / Care for the body' → Create → 'Health' appears at bottom of list with generated id budget-cat-cat-<random>. Long-press Health card → whole category removed (verified). Export to Excel triggers real CSV download; header row exactly = 'Type,Category,Subcategory,Jan,Feb,Mar,Apr,May,Jun,Jul,Aug,Sep,Oct,Nov,Dec,Annual Total'; Give/Tithe row = 'Budget,Give,Tithe,500,500,500,500,500,500,500,500,500,500,500,500,6000' after annual 6000 set. NOTE: Add Subcategory sheet opened (budget-sub-add-<cat> click returned OK) but the sheet's name/amount inputs were not visible/fillable in the test run — sub-add-save was reported MISSING at fill time. This blocked verification of long-press-subcategory-delete. Recommend manual verification or exposing dedicated testIDs for the sub-add sheet's name + amount inputs. T3 Grid view — FULL PASS. Header toggle pills budget-view-cards / budget-view-grid present. Grid cell testIDs grid-cell-tithe-{0..11} render correct amounts (Jan='—' when no auto-split, Jul='$500' after set). Tapping a grid cell opens edit sheet with correct 'Set Jul · Tithe' title. Toggling back to Cards works. T4 Per-category alerts — PASS with caveat. settings-alerts master row present ('Enable alerts / Master switch'). Per-subcategory chips alert-{subId}-{p50|p80|exceeded} all render for tithe / housing / food / <most subs>. Transportation subcategory chips missing under those exact testIDs — subcategory id in categories array may be 'transport' or similar, not 'transportation' — minor testID/id mismatch worth verifying but not blocking. Toggling 50% chip for Tithe works visually. Cannot verify BADGE appearance on Budget row because TxForm (transaction add form) has NO category/subcategory picker — it hardcodes groupId='steward' + detailId='housing' for expenses. Added $300 manual expense; Jul Tithe row still 'actual/budgeted $0/$500' as expected — the expense landed on Steward/Housing bucket instead. T5 App Lock — FULL PASS. settings-applock row shows 'Not set · Tap to set a PIN'. Tap → PIN config sheet with cfg-pin-0..9 + cfg-pin-back + cfg-pin-continue. Enter 1234 → Continue → confirm sheet → 1234 → Save. After page.reload(), AppLockGate renders full-screen with 'Jaleter' title + 'Enter your PIN to unlock' + 6-dot indicator + pin-0..9 pad. Wrong PIN 9999 resets dots. Correct 1234 dismisses gate → Home visible. Disable flow: settings-applock → cfg-pin-disable → reload → NO gate, Home loads directly. NOTE: Settings row text does NOT refresh after enabling — still shows 'Not set / Tap to set a PIN' until a full re-navigation. Cosmetic. Also multiple React-Web console errors 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' fire on the App Lock config sheet — the sheet renders but a stray text node is inside a View. Recommend wrapping any conditional/string content in <Text>. T6 Calendar booking — FULL PASS. Prev/next arrows (cal-prev / cal-next) work. Weekday header 'S M T W T F S' present. Past days & weekends visually dim (opacity 0.3). Future weekdays selectable via cal-day-YYYY-M-D. Selecting Tuesday reveals 'PICK A TIME · Tuesday, Jul 21' + 3 chips (10:00 AM / 2:00 PM / 4:00 PM). Selecting 2:00 PM highlights it. Book & Pay $50 navigates to https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_a1dPYCNNdgXiVbrFeRXQZWE0VW8qJinhNIL3u0hgLJNZdxbleEoNVzd91R... (real Stripe session) — no test card entered. T7 Cross-screen regressions — FULL PASS. Home profile pill = 'AW'. Legacy period pills = exactly [1yr,2yr,3yr,5yr,10yr,20yr,Retirement] all present. nw-restricted still editable on Net Worth. budget-earn still on Budget. No red console errors — only pre-existing RN-Web warnings ('shadow*' / 'pointerEvents') plus the new App Lock 'Unexpected text node' warnings. Post-test Mongo cleanup done (linked_accounts + bank_transactions + coaching_bookings + payment_transactions cleared; name reset to 'Alex Ward'; premium fields unset).

ui_bugs.issue: After enabling PIN via config sheet, the settings-applock row text does not refresh from 'Not set · Tap to set a PIN' to 'Enabled · PIN only' until a full re-navigation. Cosmetic — state IS persisted and gate appears on reload.

Tapping budget-sub-add-<cat_id> opens sheet (evaluated el.click returned OK) but the sheet's name + amount inputs are not addressable by the test — no dedicated testIDs on those two TextInputs, and querySelector for sub-add-save briefly reported MISSING mid-flow. Recommend adding sub-add-name + sub-add-amount testIDs and confirming the sheet renders correctly on all category ids. Add Category sheet (cat-add-save) works fine.

The add-transaction form has no UI to pick category / subcategory — expenses hardcode groupId='steward' detailId='housing', income hardcodes 'w2'. Users cannot manually record a Tithe expense, so per-subcategory alert thresholds (T4) can only be exercised via a bank-linked transaction. This blocks the T4 badge test end-to-end via the UI.

issues: Alert chip testIDs use subcategory id (e.g. alert-tithe-p50). For 'Transportation' the chip testIDs alert-transportation-{p50|p80|exceeded} were NOT found — likely the subcategory id in the categories array is 'transport' or similar; other subs (tithe, housing, food, missions, investments, emergency, education, travel, shopping, entertainment) all render correctly. Verify sub.id naming.
Carried from iter14: Home 'RETIREMENT PROJECTION' teaser computes on net worth × 8%^33 while Legacy Retirement uses investments-only. Two screens can show different retirement numbers.

react_native_issues.issue: Repeated React-Web console error: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' fires when the App Lock configure sheet opens. A stray string / whitespace text node exists inside a <View> and must be wrapped in <Text> to be RN-safe. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx ConfigurePinSheet section (around lines 140-190).
Carried from iters 10-14: RN-Web 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Reference: index.tsx StyleSheet blocks throughout.

action_items: Fix stray text node inside a <View> in the AppLock config sheet — console spam 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' fires whenever the sheet opens. Likely a naked '' string or expression like {cond && ''}. Wrap in <Text> or guard.
Refresh settings-applock row label after PIN save so it flips from 'Not set · Tap to set a PIN' to 'Enabled · PIN only' without a full re-navigation.

Add category / subcategory picker to TxForm (or a dedicated action) so users can attribute a manual expense to Give/Tithe (or any specific sub). Currently TxForm hardcodes groupId='steward' detailId='housing' — blocks per-sub alert testing end-to-end via UI.
Add testIDs to the 'Add subcategory' sheet's name and amount TextInputs (e.g. sub-add-name, sub-add-amount) so the flow is testable — the sheet was not filling in automation.
Verify Transportation subcategory id — alert chip testIDs alert-transportation-{p50|p80|exceeded} did NOT resolve while other subs did. Likely id is 'transport'. Align naming.
OPTIONAL (carried): shadow* → boxShadow and props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx PeriodPills values={[...MONTHS, 'Year']} correctly wired; default period computed from new Date().getMonth() correctly resolves to 'Jul' at test time.
index.tsx monthlyAmount / annualAmount override model: sc.months?.[mIdx] ?? sc.budgeted; annual = sum over 0..11. Setting annual writes budgeted = annual/12 and clears months. Verified end-to-end.

index.tsx commitEdit / resetOverride correctly respects the 'annual' vs specific-month branch. 'Reset Jan to auto-split' button appears only when the current period has an override and clears months[mIdx].
index.tsx exportBudgetCsv produces correct 16-column CSV header (Type,Category,Subcategory,Jan..Dec,Annual Total) and per-row monthly values including override for the current-month cell.
index.tsx Grid view (view='grid') renders a horizontal-scroll table with fixed Category column, per-month cells testID grid-cell-<subId>-<mIdx>, tapping opens the same edit sheet.

index.tsx AppLock: state persists via SecureStore; MainApp gates render on `appLock?.pin` truthy; AppLockGate uses testID pin-* on numeric buttons; disable flow via cfg-pin-disable clears state. Confirmed reload gate + wrong/correct PIN handling.
index.tsx CoachingScreen: cal-prev / cal-next / cal-day-YYYY-M-D / coaching-slot-<iso> / coaching-book — Book & Pay opens real Stripe checkout URL. No client-side hardcoded prices or amounts.
TxForm (index.tsx ~1595-1616) is minimal — no category / subcategory picker for either income or expense. This is the biggest functional gap uncovered this iteration.
Backend NOT modified this iteration; all 9 regression endpoints identical to iter14.
updated_files: Mongo pre-test: cleaned linked_accounts, bank_transactions, coaching_bookings, payment_transactions for alex+test1@jaleter.app; name → 'Alex Ward'; premium fields unset.
Mongo post-test: cleaned any residual link + booking + payment_transaction created during the SimpleFIN + Stripe portions of the run; name confirmed 'Alex Ward'; App Lock disabled at end of T5.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (T1 T3 T5 T6 T7 full pass; T2 add category/export/long-press full pass, add subcategory not fully verifiable via automation; T4 chips + toggling pass, badge-in-row not verifiable due to missing category picker in TxForm)

seed_data_creation: None retained. All test-created data (SimpleFIN link, bank_transactions, coaching_bookings, payment_transactions) removed post-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Same testIDs as iter14 plus new: budget-view-cards / budget-view-grid (header toggle), budget-period-{Jan..Dec|Year}, budget-add-category, budget-export, cat-add-save (add-category sheet), sub-add-save (add-subcat sheet — currently no dedicated name/amount testIDs on its 2 inputs), budget-edit-reset (reset-override button, only when override exists), grid-cell-<subId>-<mIdx>, budget-sub-add-<cat_id>, alert-<subId>-{p50|p80|exceeded}, settings-alerts (master), settings-applock (row), cfg-pin-{0..9|back|continue|disable}, pin-{0..9|back|bio} (AppLockGate), cal-prev, cal-next, cal-day-YYYY-M-D, coaching-slot-<iso>. IMPORTANT: RN-Web ScrollView doesn't respond to window.scrollBy — use el.click() via page.evaluate() (JS click) instead of Playwright .click(force=true) for elements below the fold; Playwright's force click at absolute coords can land on the bottom nav overlay when the target is scrolled offscreen inside a ScrollView. Give category expands by default (['give']) so budget-sub-tithe is immediately queryable. Add-subcategory sheet name/amount inputs need testIDs before it's automatable. TxForm has no category picker — expenses default to steward/housing, income to w2 — blocks per-sub alert badge verification via manual tx add. localStorage key is still 'jaleter-state-v2'.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no P0/P1 bugs blocking the batch. Three MEDIUM items surfaced: (1) TxForm lacks category picker — impossible to attach a manual expense to Tithe / any specific subcategory for alert verification. (2) Add-subcategory sheet inputs lack testIDs, so its create flow can't be fully automated (add-category works fine because its 2 inputs are the only inputs on the page at that moment; add-subcategory sheet co-exists with other inputs). (3) settings-applock row label doesn't reflect enabled state until re-navigation. All are code-level cosmetic/UX gaps rather than data-integrity or auth defects.
